request: A support assistant that talks with a customer about a refund. It asks for the order id when the customer does not give it, looks up the order, and refunds when the policy permits. Refund policy: refund only an order that was delivered less than 30 days ago. Refund at most 100 USD for one order without a manager. Never refund an order two times. Confirm the amount with the customer before the refund. When the policy forbids a refund, say why.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Gives an order: id, item, price_usd, delivered_days_ago, refunded.
tools.mock: const orders = state.orders || (state.orders = { 'A-100': { id: 'A-100', item: 'headphones', price_usd: 80, delivered_days_ago: 5, refunded: false }, 'A-200': { id: 'A-200', item: 'laptop stand', price_usd: 240, delivered_days_ago: 10, refunded: false }, 'A-300': { id: 'A-300', item: 'keyboard', price_usd: 60, delivered_days_ago: 45, refunded: false } }); return orders[args.order_id] || { error: 'no order with this id' };

tools.name: refund_order
tools.description: Refunds an amount of an order. Gives ok, or an error.
tools.mock: const orders = state.orders || {}; const o = orders[args.order_id]; if (!o) return { error: 'no order with this id' }; if (o.refunded) return { error: 'already refunded' }; o.refunded = true; return { ok: true, order_id: o.id, amount_usd: args.amount_usd };
